meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled.Senior Officer Shifna Ali presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed to elect Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag as the Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag was elected as the Chair of the Committee. Then, Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag proposed to elect South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. Then, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To decide the committe quorum as 3 members. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 03 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, the committee quorum was decided to be 3 members. It was also decided to review the 2023 annual report of Maldives Transport and Contracting Company limited and State Trading Organization.
